leakage_attacks.metadata_interpretation: both probe and full models use label-blind features; a probe difference within the declared practical comparison margin is recorded but not interpreted as the metadata probe winning, and no superiority claim is available to either side

multiplicity_control.comparison_family: three co-primary models by seven surface baselines and two primary metrics

near_duplicate_checks.comparison_unit: cross-split family pairs over padded code sets and typed-token sets
near_duplicate_checks.declaration_rule: a flagged pair is declared iff both families share the same frozen near-duplicate template key; undeclared flagged pairs fail closed

family_shuffle.comparison_basis: family-shuffle held-out balanced_accuracy must sit strictly below every co-primary model that is itself above chance (balanced_accuracy > 0.5); a chance-level co-primary model provides no signal to lose against and is excluded, and an empty comparator set fails closed
family_shuffle.description: within-family label correspondence is scrambled while preserving family class totals; the interpretable model refits on those same held-out rows with scrambled labels and scores their original labels. This is not an out-of-sample prediction or proof that family-prevalence leakage is absent.
